scope: Independent complete criteria/CLI/browser source and literal original-oracle review, with final mechanical version-delta/identity checks. No driver, candidate, product or browser execution by this reviewer.
findings: Exact unchanged original JSON is used for default and explicit JSON modes and both embedded and actual downloaded report bytes, including final LF.

The typed fixture covers missing versus null, boolean versus integer, integer versus float, signed zero, literal Unicode/markup identifiers, seven changed fields and complete first/second documents. The separate order-only oracle retains no field changes but records order and saved-value differences.

Occupied-output and selected-input destinations must refuse; malformed declared identity must refuse before new output. Watched fixture/original/candidate source preservation is independently recorded.
CLI v2 kills and reaps its own timed-out child while retaining raw streams and the failed outcome. No additional execution was required for this source review.
Browser v2 retains its owned profile and marks failure when context closure is uncertain; only a confirmed closed context permits its own profile cleanup.

Browser v3 corrects the one concrete layout-observation defect: an empty boolean open attribute is already open. It now expands only details whose open attribute is None. The sole other v2-to-v3 change is the output directory version.
Actual file-origin desktop/narrow observations, saved-data labels, identities and exact JSON download are coherent. The driver avoids imposing a particular value table or pre/code structure.
manual_visual_gate: Root must independently compare the retained full body/fragments and both actual viewport screenshots with all seven typed differences and complete first/second documents, including local scrolling or wrapping. Token checks alone do not establish visible value completeness. This review accepts the receiving harness, not a future HTML result.
history: Original v1 and v2 files/freezes remain retained. Final executable-freeze-v3 explicitly states no candidate/browser course has run; its executed_versions field lists the versions selected for the future course, not an execution result.
limits: This is authored saved-data input, not a live operational chronology or provider/Ledger workflow.
Candidate source review, actual executions, native browser environment admission and publication custody remain separate gates.
